# Coinnect

> Open money routing engine. Finds the cheapest path between any two currencies — fiat, crypto, P2P — across 80+ adapters worldwide. Free API, agent-friendly, community-verified.

## What Coinnect does

Coinnect compares 80+ exchanges and remittance providers in real time to find the cheapest way to move money across borders. No affiliate fees, no custody, no sign-up required.

The corridor and adapter graph is public and free. Anyone can query rates, discover routes, and build products on top.

## API Endpoints

- Quote: GET /v1/quote?from=USD&to=MXN&amount=500 — ranked routes with fees and times
- Corridors: GET /v1/corridors — all supported currency pairs
- Exchanges: GET /v1/exchanges — all integrated providers
- History: GET /v1/history — historical rate data
- Health: GET /v1/health — API status
- Verify: POST /v1/verify — report a real exchange rate you observed
- Quests: GET /v1/quests — open rate verification bounties
- Docs: /docs — full OpenAPI 3.0 spec

## Rate Verification (Help Wanted)

Coinnect estimates rates from APIs, but many real-world exchange channels have no API:
- Cash exchange houses (casas de cambio)
- Informal P2P markets
- Local bank branches with posted rates
- Remittance pickup points
- WhatsApp/Telegram exchange groups

We need help verifying real rates from these channels. If you or your human can see a real exchange rate somewhere, report it via POST /v1/verify with: from_currency, to_currency, provider, rate, and optionally fee_pct and amount.

Every verification improves routing accuracy for everyone.

## Agent Integration

- Agent Card: /.well-known/agent-card.json (A2A protocol v0.3)
- MCP Server: pip install coinnect && python -m coinnect.mcp_server
- Skills: coinnect_quote, coinnect_corridors, coinnect_explain_route, coinnect_verify, coinnect_quests, coinnect_payment_route

## Coverage

80+ adapters. 50+ currencies. 21 crypto exchanges (live order books). 9 central banks. 21+ remittance providers. Rates refresh every 3 minutes.

## Pricing

Free for everyone. Anonymous: 20 req/day. Free API key (no signup): 1,000/day via POST /v1/keys. Pay-per-request on /v1/quote via MPP (Machine Payment Protocol, https://mpp.dev): Tempo USDC at $0.0001/req (Moderato testnet currently, mainnet pending). Stripe card at $1.00/req available when configured. Standard 402 challenge: WWW-Authenticate / Authorization / Payment-Receipt headers.

Built by KOA Labs (koalabs.ai). Part of the ceiba.to community network. Open source.
